title: Zoom Build platform request Authorization Bearer slot shared by an API key and a JWT
summary: An Authorization Bearer value on a Build platform request, which Zoom documents as carrying either an API key or a JWT generated from the key and secret.
rationale: Claim api-request-carriers records that x-api-key is API-key-only, that Authorization: Bearer takes an API key or a JWT, and that x-api-key takes precedence when both are sent; the x-api-key header already has its own Cases. Nothing in a request distinguishes a Bearer API key from a Bearer JWT (open question bearer-slot-is-shared). Whether a client-held JWT is confidential is not stated (build-jwt-structure-unstated), whether the key is one string or a key and secret pair in the current flow is not stated (key-secret-pair-or-single-string) and no grammar is stated (value-grammar-unstated). Attribution of a Bearer value to the key or to the JWT is therefore not settled, and a Bearer positive would assert a key where the slot may hold a JWT. Contract claims cited: build-platform-api-key/api-request-carriers, build-platform-api-key/usage-guidance-key-versus-jwt.

expectation.rationale: No outcome is asserted for the Bearer slot. Settled by: a Zoom page that shows the key's issuance in the current flow and the Build API JWT's construction and confidentiality.

sources.supports: Bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer TOKEN` using your API Key or JWT.
